_comment: Missions launched from the territory map (issue #5). province: where the map offers it. map: text map in maps/. story: true = plays once. after: only offered once that mission is cleared. needs: story conditions (scripts/story.gd Story.meets, issue #18). intro: a talk played when the mission starts (first time only). objective: {kind, ...} read by scripts/objective.gd (kills: count). rewards: paid on success (gilt, supplies, ink, renown, insight). fray: change to the province's Fray on success (negative pushes the Blank back). enemies: optional spawn weights that replace the province roster in data/enemies.json (#16). gate (issue #28): story conditions that keep a story mission on the map but locked, with the first missing one shown as the reason. on_success (issue #28): story effects on the first win: grant (provinces that become yours), join (recruits who join on the spot), standing ({faction: change}). loot: per-kill chance [0-1] and amount range of what the party picks up on the way; retreating keeps it, being wiped out loses it.

missions.name: Prologue: Spat Out
missions.brief: Something spat you out of the Blank in the Frayed Meadow, and the Nibblers want you back. Drive them off and find your way to Hollowmark.

missions.name: Chapter 1: No Such Person
missions.brief: The Blank is eating the Concord tax office with you locked inside it. Bran has the key. The wardens have other ideas.

missions.name: The Concord Answers
missions.brief: A Concord tithe column is marching on Hollowmark to collect 'all outstanding sums', meaning you. Break it at Old Mill Crossing before it reaches the gate.

missions.name: Patrol: Frayed Meadow
missions.brief: The Nibblers keep crawling out of the white. Thin them out before they reach the road, and the Meadow frays a little slower.

missions.name: Patrol: Gutterwoods
missions.brief: The letter-moths are thick between the trees again. Clear the trail so the Coven's couriers get through.

missions.name: Patrol: Saltreed Marsh
missions.brief: Reedlings have been spitting at anyone on the boardwalks. Wade in and thin them out.

missions.name: Patrol: Old Mill Crossing
missions.brief: Something stitched the mill's scarecrows back together. Put them down before the harvest rots.

missions.name: Patrol: Wickham Hills
missions.brief: The ink spring draws things out of the hills. Walk the lamp road and see what comes.

missions.name: Patrol: The Tithe Road
missions.brief: Guild sellswords are working the Concord road. Make the toll they collect a painful one.

missions.name: Boss: The Auditor
missions.brief: The Concord has sent its answer to an unregistered town: the Auditor, who strikes people out of the Ledger with a quill the size of a lance. He is waiting at the Tithe Road tollgate, and Hollowmark is next on his list. Watch the red lanes and the dotted lines, and hit him when his nib sticks.

missions.name: Chapter 2: The Wax Barges
missions.brief: The Erasers are burning the wax barges at Candleford, the lake town that makes Saint Ledger's candles. Get down to the jetty and keep the last barge afloat. Nobody holds Candleford yet: save it and it is yours.

steps.label: Get down to the wax jetty
banter: White fire. No heat off it. That ain't right.

steps.label: Drive the Erasers off the jetty

elite.name: Reader Grice, keeper of the list

banter: They're readin' names at us. While they swing.
done_banter: One boat left. Let's keep it.

steps.label: Keep the Erasers' tapers off the last barge
steps.say: The Erasers want the last barge. Stand between them and the wax.
steps.fail: The last barge went up in white fire. Candleford will make candles for nobody this winter.

steps.label: Walk back up through the town

missions.name: Chapter 2: The Copying Hall
missions.brief: Prioress Ebba will let you into Saint Ledger's now that Candleford has someone in charge. Things that used to be brothers do penance in the cloister walk. Get through to the copying hall and light the candles at its three lecterns, so the copyists can see what they are writing.

objective.label: Meet the Prioress at the gate

steps.label: Walk the cloister
banter: Candles in every niche and still dark. Takes effort, that does.

steps.label: Put the penitents to rest
steps.say: Penitents wipe off what they touch. Keep your distance from their hands.
done_banter: They was monks. Now they ain't. Let's not stop and think about it.

steps.label: Light the candles at the three lecterns
steps.say: Copyists strike a strip of floor out of the world. Step off the dotted line.

steps.label: Out the way you came, with the Prioress

missions.name: Chapter 2: The Crypts
missions.brief: The Erasers took the Bonefield Cloister a month ago and sealed its crypt-keeper, Sister Osyth, underground. Break their camp, go down the crypt stair and bring her out. The Ledger says the hill was always empty.

steps.label: Break the Erasers' camp
banter: Readers up front, washers behind. Same drill as a tithe line. Go.
done_banter: Askew's gone. Left the tents. Didn't leave the fire.

steps.label: Down the crypt stair
banter: Steps go down further than the hill goes up. I'm only sayin'.

steps.label: Hold the stair while Osyth opens the Founders' Door
steps.fail: The crypt took Sister Osyth before she reached the last row.

steps.label: Bring Sister Osyth up into the light

missions.name: Boss: The Abbot Who Copied Himself
missions.brief: Abbot Wulfstan has locked the copying hall and copied himself, several times. Only one of him is real: his hands drip ink. Hit the copies and they tear, but they come back. Watch his crozier, the dotted lines, and the ring of light when he illuminates.

missions._comment: The climax betrayal, Chapter 6 (issue #186): the betrayer's fight in their home written as words, offered once Chapter 5 has locked them (needs betrayer), even when the home is erased (in_blank). The gesture is the outro talk's choice. Chapter 6 (#32) adds its own 'after'.
missions.name: The Betrayal: Ottoline's Door
missions.brief: Ottoline took the Vacancy's deal and walked Ash into the white. She is standing guard over the Encore's red door, inside Gallows Ferry as the Blank keeps it. She fights the way she always did: the shoulder charge down a lane, both fists into the floor, and one punch you will see coming for a long time.

objective.label: Bring Ottoline down. Don't finish her.

missions.name: The Betrayal: Daro's Road
missions.brief: Daro signed the Vacancy's form and handed Ash over. They are waiting on the Tithe Road as written, beside a Hob's Wick that may or may not be real. Watch the point: the long lunge, the sweep up close, and the Skewer, a line the length of the road.

objective.label: Bring Daro down. Don't finish them.

missions.name: The Betrayal: Odile's Account
missions.brief: Odile entered the deal in her ledger and paid it with Ash. She is at Old Mill Crossing as written, outside the Honest Measure. Levy drains you to heal her; stand out of her Audit seals, or her hits land half again as hard.

objective.label: Bring Odile down. Don't finish her.

missions._comment: Bran's con paid off (issue #186): he sold Ash for a price the Vacancy can't pay, and it is in breach. Brings him home (on_success betrayal: con_home).
missions.name: The Con: Bran's Thursday
missions.brief: Bran sold Ash to the Vacancy for everything it ever ate, back, by Thursday. It said yes. It is Thursday. Find him at the landing in Gallows Ferry as written, and keep the Vacancy's collectors off him while he makes it pay.

steps.label: Keep the collectors off Bran while the Vacancy fails to pay
steps.fail: The collectors got to the contract. The Vacancy is not in breach any more.

missions.name: Patrol: Candleford
missions.brief: White coats still row out at night to the barges. Walk the lake shore and see who is carrying a taper.

missions.name: Patrol: Saint Ledger's
missions.brief: The Prioress asks for the abbey lands to be walked. Penitents wander out of the cloister and into the orchards.

missions.name: Patrol: The Bonefield
missions.brief: The Erasers left, but their fires did not all go out. Walk the hill and stamp out what is still burning.

missions.name: Patrol: Scarth Pass
missions.brief: Pilgrims, bandits and penitents share the pass road. Walk it and keep the pines clear.
